cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(qwen_robotnav_progress)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(nav2_core REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp REQUIRED)
find_package(rclcpp_lifecycle REQUIRED)
find_package(geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(pluginlib REQUIRED)
find_package(tf2_ros REQUIRED)
find_package(tf2_geometry_msgs REQUIRED)
find_package(nav2_regulated_pure_pursuit_controller REQUIRED)
add_library(${PROJECT_NAME} SHARED src/stable_progress_checker.cpp)
target_include_directories(${PROJECT_NAME} PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include>)
ament_target_dependencies(${PROJECT_NAME} nav2_core rclcpp rclcpp_lifecycle geometry_msgs pluginlib tf2_ros tf2_geometry_msgs)
add_library(qwen_robotnav_return SHARED src/return_controller.cpp)
target_include_directories(qwen_robotnav_return PRIVATE include)
ament_target_dependencies(qwen_robotnav_return nav2_core rclcpp rclcpp_lifecycle geometry_msgs pluginlib tf2_ros tf2_geometry_msgs nav2_regulated_pure_pursuit_controller)
pluginlib_export_plugin_description_file(nav2_core progress_plugins.xml)
pluginlib_export_plugin_description_file(nav2_core controller_plugins.xml)
install(TARGETS ${PROJECT_NAME} qwen_robotnav_return LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(DIRECTORY include/ DESTINATION include)
if(BUILD_TESTING)
  enable_testing()
  add_executable(test_stable_progress test/test_stable_progress.cpp)
  target_include_directories(test_stable_progress PRIVATE include)
  add_test(NAME stable_progress COMMAND test_stable_progress)
  add_executable(test_return_phase test/test_return_phase.cpp)
  target_include_directories(test_return_phase PRIVATE include)
  add_test(NAME return_phase COMMAND test_return_phase)
  add_executable(test_runtime_plugin_loading test/test_runtime_plugin_loading.cpp)
  ament_target_dependencies(test_runtime_plugin_loading nav2_core pluginlib)
  add_test(NAME runtime_plugin_loading COMMAND test_runtime_plugin_loading)
  add_executable(test_approach_goal_checker test/test_approach_goal_checker.cpp)
  target_include_directories(test_approach_goal_checker PRIVATE include)
  ament_target_dependencies(test_approach_goal_checker nav2_core)
  add_test(NAME approach_goal_checker COMMAND test_approach_goal_checker)
  add_executable(replay_recorded_progress test/replay_recorded_progress.cpp)
  target_include_directories(replay_recorded_progress PRIVATE include)
endif()
ament_export_include_directories(include)
ament_export_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME})
ament_export_dependencies(nav2_core rclcpp rclcpp_lifecycle geometry_msgs pluginlib tf2_ros tf2_geometry_msgs)
ament_package()
